items.title: GitHub - mitaku/andon: A one-person software factory: AI coding agents take tasks from a ledger through review to merge, and call the human only for decisions only they can make.
items.summary: Andon — a one-person software factory. AI coding agents take issues from a ledger through implementation, review and merge, and the human is called only for the decisions that only they can make. 一人で使うソフトウェア工場。エージェントが kanban の課題を実装・レビュー・マージまで流し、オーナーは...
